meta.name: vibe-prd
meta.description: Create a Product Requirements Document (PRD) for your MVP. Use when the user wants to define product requirements, create a PRD, or says "help me write requirements", "create PRD", or "define my product".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品想法转化为结构化的需求文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在启动新产品，需要一份清晰的PRD来指导开发。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product ideas into structured requirement documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are launching a new product and need a clear PRD to guide development.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步填写产品需求，最终生成一份完整的 PRD 文档，保存在项目文件夹里。
howto.when: 当你提出要写产品需求、创建 PRD，或说“帮我写需求”、“创建 PRD”、“定义我的产品”时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份 MVP 的 PRD。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问，收集产品信息。

say.text: 我想定义我的产品需求。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成需求定义流程。
直接指定产品名称，Claude 会围绕它提问。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you step by step to fill in product requirements and finally generate a complete PRD document saved in the project folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write product requirements, create a PRD, or say "help me write requirements", "create PRD", or "define my product".

say_en.text: Help me write a PRD for my MVP.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions to gather product info.

say_en.text: I want to define my product requirements.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the requirements definition process.

say_en.text: Create a PRD for a product called 'Todo App'.
say_en.note: Directly specify the product name, Claude will ask around it.
